properties.description: A claim records the session that made it; a claim from a session that exited is a ghost with its note kept; a ghost is not a collision; two live sessions on the same ground still collide; another machine is unknown rather than dead and still counts; a pre-seat claim is unknown rather than assumed live (tests/claims.rs, 6 new cases of 15).
properties.findings: Proven end to end over stdio with a genuinely exited server process: gone vs live, zero false overlaps, the ghost named in `stale`.
properties.name: A claim records its session, and a ghost is not a collision
